data.website_text: E-mail Web Pages Web Hosting Web Applications Internet Intranet Welcome to Worldwide Computer Solutions, Inc. Worldwide Computer Solutions offers web page development, web page hosting, web page application development, Internet and Intranet consulting, and presentations on the subject of world wide web technology. We have been offering this capability since the world wide web became available. Our staff has extensive experience developing functional web sites that contribute to your business or organizational goals. We have a unique approach to client web development that involves the client in every step of the evolution of a web presence. And, we encourage our clients to maintain their web sites once they are operational. If you wish, we will work hand-in-hand with your staff during the development phase so that they learn the process and are equipped to maintain the site. Of course, you may develop the site entirely and just use our server to present it to the world. We have developed over 70 web sites and will be pleased to provide references upon request. Of course, we provide you with a report of your activity. We will mail the report to you each week. We will assist you with analysis of the report, if desired.
